systems.system: Recensement des écoles et universités 2024-2025 / StatEduc2 (higher education)
systems.country_label: recensement; annuaire statistique de l'enseignement supérieur; plateforme StatEduc2
systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education (MESRIT), Direction des Statistiques et de l'Informatique, with INS support
systems.tiers: higher-education establishments only: questionnaires filled once a year by focal points, partly on paper and partly in Excel (June-July 2025), keyed centrally in July 2025 and loaded into StatEduc2

note: Higher education only, which the study leaves out; the method chapter describes a yearly census of 216 establishments and names no system for primary or secondary schools.
